seriesTitle: Dear Killer Nannies: Criado por sicarios

episodes.title: El fin de la inocencia
episodes.summary: Juampi grows up surrounded by luxury and violence, raised by Pablo Escobar's hitmen.

episodes.title: Enfrentar al miedo
episodes.summary: Juampi confronts the truth about his father as he seeks to break free from a legacy that haunts him.

episodes.title: El hombre de la casa
episodes.summary: Despite the exile, the last name Escobar becomes an impossible burden for Juan Pablo and his family.

episodes.title: Aprender a renunciar
episodes.summary: Juan Pablo seeks to break with his past, confronting those who want to see him dead face-to-face.

episodes.title: Renacer
episodes.summary: Locked up and persecuted, the Escobar family seeks a way out to start a new life.

episodes.title: Perder la ilusión
episodes.summary: Caught between power struggles and betrayals, Juan Pablo seeks to regain control of his life.

episodes.title: La última lección
episodes.summary: Amidst suspicions and while everything collapses, Juampi has a connection him with his roots.

episodes.title: No mirar atrás
episodes.summary: Juampi suffers new losses while hidden truths emerge, bringing him face to face with his father.
